compiled_state.title: Add DOM-cross-check regression test with mismatch and consistent fixture JSON
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-5: DOM-cross-check regression test asserts dom_xpath_visually_consistent correctly reflects bbox-to-DOM agreement on a fixture with a known mismatch

## Implementation Notes
Create tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_domcheck.py with:

1. Fixture files:
   - tests/plugin/fixtures/visual-evaluator/mismatch-fixture-expected.json — golden output where bbox_confidence="inferred" AND dom_xpath_visually_consistent=false (bbox and xpath known to disagree)
   - tests/plugin/fixtures/visual-evaluator/consistent-fixture-expected.json — output where bbox_confidence="anchored" AND dom_xpath_visually_consistent=true

2. Tests:
   - test_mismatch_fixture_inconsistent: load mismatch fixture, assert dom_xpath_visually_consistent==False for at least one finding
   - test_consistent_fixture_consistent: load consistent fixture, assert dom_xpath_visually_consistent==True for all findings
   - test_fixtures_schema_conformant: both fixtures validate against plugins/dso/docs/visual-evaluator-schema.json
   - test_anchored_bbox_requires_dom_xpath: fixture with bbox_confidence="anchored" and null dom_xpath should fail schema (document as a schema-level constraint or behavioral note)

Note: dom_xpath_visually_consistent is a VLM judgment, not a live DOM query. Fixtures encode the "known" expected output values for regression.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Mismatch fixture asserts dom_xpath_visually_consistent==False
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_domcheck.py::test_mismatch_fixture_inconsistent -v
- [ ] Consistent fixture asserts dom_xpath_visually_consistent==True
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_domcheck.py::test_consistent_fixture_consistent -v
- [ ] Both fixtures validate against the visual-evaluator schema
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_domcheck.py::test_fixtures_schema_conformant -v

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
